section_summary.extract_value: This Methods section describes a single study conducted at Ohio State University with college students recruited from psychology classes. The study involved an initial survey (n=675; 367 women, 308 men; Mage=20.34) and a 20-day follow-up test-retest assessment (n=208; 135 women, 73 men; Mage=20.27). Participants completed an online survey assessing body appreciation using the BAS-2, along with measures of appearance evaluation, body dissatisfaction, media internalization, body surveillance, self-esteem, proactive coping, intuitive eating, and eating disorder symptomatology. BMI was calculated from self-reported height and weight.
